A fusion reactor module that draws power straight from the reactor's plasma, to charge the ship's SMES units far faster than the grid can. Every kWh it delivers burns extra reactor fuel.

Sold only to licensed operators. Its manual is short, and most of it is a non-disclosure agreement.

A superconducting magnetic energy storage unit. Its coil holds a large charge in a current that never decays, and can give it all up in moments, for equipment that needs more power than a ship's grid can supply. It connects to an adjacent conduit, and charges slowly from the grid or quickly from a SMES reactor tap.

The coil is proprietary. The casing carries no maker's mark, and opening it voids more than the warranty.
